name: Bamboo Hermitage
description: A single sleeping nook, paper windows, tiled gable and outdoor storage under deep eaves.

name: Cherry Tea House
description: Pink timber, a shaded tea veranda, sleeping corner and a stone approach.

name: Cedar Minka
description: A steep gable, exposed beams, twin beds, pantry and a covered hearth.

name: Lantern Shop House
description: A front counter, deep pantry, hanging lanterns and a separate upstairs dwelling.

name: Riverside Stilt House
style: Southeast Asian-inspired bamboo and timber dwelling
description: A raised living floor, shaded fishing deck, long access stair and a small enclosed pond.

name: Scholar's Courtyard
description: A tiled study, sleeping wing, and kitchen enclose a lotus court with bamboo and covered entry.

name: Moon Gate Villa
description: Low dark roofs frame a U-shaped timber home, an open garden, and a quiet pond beside the entry walk.

name: Mountain Lodge
style: Tibetan inspired raised stone and timber home
description: A whitewashed lodge on a broad stone terrace has a timber balcony, capped roof, and stair to a private upper room.

name: Jade Clan Manor
description: A red-pillared family compound with two open courts, jade tile roofs, sleeping wings, kitchen, and formal rear hall.

name: Cloud Pagoda Residence
style: Japanese pagoda inspired multistory family residence
description: Four furnished living floors connected by interior stairs rise over a garden, tea room, and bath annex.
